description: This Kotlin source file defines functionality for handling photo retrieval in an Android application, including permission checks, querying media store, decoding and scaling images, encoding images to JPEG base64, and packaging photo data for external use. It includes data classes, an interface for sources, a concrete implementation for system photos, and a handler class for processing photo requests through JSON input.

classes.name: PhotosLatestRequest
classes.description: Data class representing the parameters for fetching latest photos, including limit, maximum width, and quality.

classes.name: EncodedPhotoPayload
classes.description: Data class encapsulating photo data such as format, base64-encoded content, dimensions, and creation time.

classes.name: PhotosDataSource
classes.description: Interface for photo data sources defining permission check and fetching latest photos method.

classes.name: SystemPhotosDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing PhotosDataSource, accessing device media store with permission checks, querying recent photos, decoding, scaling, and encoding images.

classes.name: PhotosHandler
classes.description: Main class that handles photo requests, parsing JSON parameters, checking permissions, retrieving photos via a data source, and returning results in JSON format.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read photos, depending on Android SDK version.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos up to the specified limit, scales and encodes images, and returns a list of EncodedPhotoPayload.

methods.name: queryLatestRows
methods.description: Queries media store for the most recent photo entries with optional sorting by date taken or added.

methods.name: decodeScaledBitmap
methods.description: Decodes an image Uri into a scaled Bitmap considering maximum width.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Computes sample size for image decoding to efficiently scale images.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a Bitmap into JPEG format as base64 string, reducing quality or size to stay within character budget.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest
methods.description: Processes a JSON request to retrieve latest photos, checking permissions, parsing parameters, and returning a JSON payload.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into a PhotosLatestRequest object, applying default values and validation.

methods.name: forTesting
methods.description: Factory method to create PhotosHandler with custom data source for testing purposes.
